items.title: Flagship Datasets

children.title: EgoLife
children.description: A ~300-hour egocentric, interpersonal, multiview, multimodal dataset of six people living together for one week wearing AI glasses, accompanied by the EgoLifeQA long-context daily-assistance benchmark. [paper]

repo_info.description: [CVPR 2025] EgoLife: Towards Egocentric Life Assistant

children.title: EgoDex
children.description: 829 hours of 30 fps 1080p egocentric video (338K demonstrations across 194 tabletop manipulation tasks) collected with Apple Vision Pro, paired with 3D head, upper-body, and hand pose plus natural-language annotations. [paper]

repo_info.description: EgoDex: Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Large-Scale Egocentric Video

children.title: ParaHome
children.description: 486 minutes from 38 participants capturing 3D body and dexterous hand motion with multiple articulated household objects in a shared home environment, with text descriptions. [paper] [code]

repo_info.description: Parameterizing Everyday Home Activities Towards 3D Generative Modeling of Human-Object Interactions

children.title: LaMAria
children.description: City-scale egocentric visual-inertial SLAM benchmark captured with Aria glasses over hours and kilometers of trajectories, with survey-grade control points providing centimeter-accurate ground truth. [paper] [code]

repo_info.description: Benchmarking Visual-Inertial SLAM at City Scale (ICCV 2025).

children.title: EgoSchema
children.description: A very long-form video question-answering benchmark derived from Ego4D with over 5,000 human-curated multiple-choice QA pairs spanning over 250 hours of egocentric video, each question grounded in a three-minute clip. [paper] [code]

children.title: Minerva-Ego
children.description: Egocentric video QA benchmark of 1,160 hand-crafted multiple-choice questions over 156 HD-EPIC videos, each paired with spatiotemporally grounded reasoning traces and object masks. [paper]

children.title: Ego4D Goal-Step
children.description: Hierarchical goal–step–substep annotations over Ego4D, with 2,807 hours carrying goal labels and 430 hours of fine-grained step labels (48K step segments). [paper]

repo_info.description: Ego4D Goal-Step: Toward Hierarchical Understanding of Procedural Activities (NeurIPS 2023)

children.title: EgoCom
children.description: A natural conversations dataset containing multi-modal human communication data captured simultaneously from the participants' egocentric perspectives.

repo_info.description: EgoCom: A Multi-person Multi-modal Egocentric Communications Dataset

children.title: EgoHumans
children.description: 125K+ egocentric images from an in-the-wild multi-view multi-human capture setup (tennis, fencing, volleyball), with 3D pose, mesh, and tracking ground truth. [paper]

repo_info.description: [ICCV, 2023] Multiple humans in 3D captured by dynamic and static cameras in 4K.

children.title: EgoExo-Fitness
children.description: Full-body action-understanding dataset of synchronized egocentric and exocentric fitness videos from 40 participants performing 86 types of fitness action sequences, with two-level temporal boundaries, technical-keypoint verification, language comments, and action-quality scores. [paper]

repo_info.description: (ECCV 2024) Official repository of paper "EgoExo-Fitness: Towards Egocentric and Exocentric Full-Body Action Understanding"

children.title: EgoPER
children.description: 28 hours of egocentric procedural cooking videos across 5 tasks with normal and erroneous executions, multiple modalities (audio, depth, hand tracking), frame-wise step labels, and object bounding boxes for error detection. [paper] [code]

repo_info.description: The official implementation of Error Detection in Egocentric Procedural Task Videos

children.title: EPIC-Contact
children.description: About 2,300 egocentric video clips (62,300 annotated frames) of bimanual hand-object interactions across nine everyday kitchen objects, for in-the-wild 3D hand-object pose estimation. [paper] [code]

repo_info.description: Code for HOPformer released in ECCV 2026 Paper "Towards in-the-wild Egocentric 3D Hand-Object Pose Estimation"

children.title: EgoAVU
children.description: Egocentric audio-visual understanding suite with a 3M-sample instruction-tuning set (EgoAVU-Instruct) and a manually verified evaluation benchmark (EgoAVU-Bench) covering grounding, temporal reasoning, scene understanding, and audio-visual hallucination. [paper]

repo_info.description: [CVPR 2026 highlight] Official release of EgoAVU Egocentric Audio-Visual Understanding

children.title: Object Search Dataset
children.description: 57 sequences of 55 subjects on search and retrieval tasks.

repo_info.description: Deep Future Gaze: Gaze Anticipation on Egocentric Videos Using Adversarial Networks

children.title: EPFL-Smart-Kitchen-30
children.description: 29.7 hours of 16 subjects cooking four recipes with synchronized exocentric (9 RGB-D cameras) and egocentric (HoloLens 2) video, depth, IMUs, eye gaze, and body/hand kinematics, densely annotated for four action and motion understanding benchmarks. [paper]

repo_info.description: EPFL-Smart-Kitchen-30 dataset is a multi-view action dataset with synchronized exocentric, egocentric, depth, IMUs, eye gaze, body and hand kinematics spanning 29.7 hours of 16 subjects cooking four different recipes.

children.title: EgoExOR
children.description: 94 minutes (84,553 frames at 15 FPS) of two emulated spine procedures combining egocentric data (RGB, gaze, hand tracking, audio) from wearable glasses with exocentric RGB-D and ultrasound, annotated with 568,235 scene-graph triplets. [paper]

repo_info.description: Official code of the paper "EgoExOR: EgoExOR: An Ego-Exo-Centric Operating Room Dataset for Surgical Activity Understanding" accepted at NeurIPS 2025

children.title: EgoMask
children.description: A pixel-level spatiotemporal grounding benchmark (with training set EgoMask-Train) built specifically for egocentric video. [paper]

repo_info.description: [ICCV 2025] "Fine-grained Spatiotemporal Grounding on Egocentric Videos"

children.title: EgoBody3M
children.description: Large-scale real-image dataset for egocentric body tracking from VR-headset SLAM cameras, with more than 30 hours of recordings and about 3 million frames of diverse subjects and motions. [paper]

repo_info.description: EgoBody3M Egocentric Body Tracking on a VR Headset using a Diverse Dataset

children.title: MyEgo
children.description: Egocentric VideoQA dataset with 541 long videos and 5K personalized questions about the camera wearer's things, activities, and past, designed to evaluate MLLM ego-grounding. [paper]

repo_info.description: [CVPR 2026] The dataset and code for "Ego-Grounding for Personalized Question-Answering in Egocentric Videos"
